answer: A new agent can only join the shared ledger after existing trusted agents form a bridge of endorsements to it, each endorser staking reputation that is lost if the newcomer cheats. No single sponsor can mint unlimited identities, because endorsements are scarce and publicly visible, so a sybil farm would need to corrupt many independent members. Reputation rises slowly toward its zenith only through honest work, while a newcomer starts in a quiet lagoon of limited privileges until its record earns wider trust.
